_README: Hand-kept employee headcount decisions, one entry per 10-K accession, read by src/data_extract/utils/fundamentals/fundamentals_employees.py. A filing whose date has no row in fundamentals_employees takes `employees` from here (null = the filing states no usable count) instead of the LLM. Seeded 2026-10-03 from the run manifest's employee outcomes: saved counts re-checked against their quote with the current guard (full-time only, bounds resolved), no_headcount and current-rule ambiguous as null; the 975 ambiguous decisions made under the previous guard were left out so the LLM re-decides them. Edit by hand; the pipeline never writes this file.
